narr: A weak frontal zone was oriented southwest to northeast across central North Carolina. Scattered showers and storms developed during the late afternoon and evening within a highly anomalous moisture environment. Some training storms led to several instances of flash flooding over the eastern and northeastern Piedmont, especially across Wake County.
ev: Pigeon House Creek at Fenton Street exceeded minor flood stage, with impacts of inundated buildings adjacent to Capital Boulevard.
The USGS Marsh Creek gage at New Hope exceeded minor flood stage, flooding a parking lot upstream of Stony Brook Drive and water approaching residential areas.
The USGS Walnut Creek gage at Rose Lane in Raleigh exceeded minor flood stage.
